original_requirement: The route quote reads two unsigned bytes: fragile weight and ordinary weight. Charge twice the fragile weight plus ordinary weight. Return a two-byte big-endian quote. Reject quotes above 600 as QUOTE at the fragile weight, after reading both bytes but before trailing-data rejection. Exactly two bytes are required.
